Title: training-HydroShare-101
description: HydroShare 101 training module

summary_data.summary_text: CIROH-UA/training-HydroShare-101 is intended by its repository metadata to be a HydroShare 101 training module, but the provided contents are largely the default, uncustomized The Carpentries Workbench Markdown lesson template. The repository includes template documentation for configuring a Carpentries lesson site, enabling GitHub Pages, editing config.yaml, updating citation, contributing, code of conduct, and license files, and building lesson material with the sandpaper Workbench system. The current lesson landing page states only that it is a new lesson built with The Carpentries Workbench. No substantive HydroShare tutorial episodes, hydrology workflows, data access examples, or operational training content are present in the supplied files. The repository is best characterized as an early-stage or placeholder training materials repository using the Carpentries Workbench lesson infrastructure.

Title: training-NGIAB-101
description: This repository will be used for preparing training module for NGIAB

summary_data.summary_text: CIROH-UA/training-NGIAB-101 is a Carpentries Workbench-based training materials repository for an introductory NGIAB 101 lesson. It is intended to provide a hands-on learning module for NextGen In A Box (NGIAB), a modular open-source hydrologic modeling framework associated with the NextGen Framework and U.S. National Water Model community modeling efforts. The stated lesson scope covers the complete NGIAB modeling workflow, including installation, data preparation, model execution, evaluation, and visualization, with optional advanced topics for high-performance computing environments. The repository includes standard lesson infrastructure and governance files such as README, citation metadata, contribution guidelines, license information, code of conduct, and top-level Carpentries Workbench lesson pages. The instructional material is licensed under CC-BY-4.0, with example software governed by an MIT-style Carpentries software license where applicable.

Title: varnish
description: Template for pkgdown site

summary_data.summary_text: CIROH-UA/varnish is a template and theming package for building Carpentries Workbench lesson websites adapted from pkgdown. It provides HTML Mustache templates, SCSS/CSS styling, JavaScript assets, logos, icons, favicons, navigation layouts, footers, metadata handling, and lesson page structures used by sandpaper to render Carpentries lessons. The package is not intended to be called directly by lesson authors; sandpaper detects it and copies the templates and styling into lesson websites. Core workflows include installing the R package from the Carpentries R-universe, using pkgdown template parameters supplied by sandpaper, and rebuilding/minifying CSS and JavaScript locally or via GitHub Actions using Node.js, npm, Sass, and uglify-js. The templates support lesson pages such as chapters/episodes, syllabi, extra pages, overview pages, sidebars, headers, navigation, footers, JSON metadata, instructor views, all-in-one pages, schedule/resources sidebars, multilingual dropdown menus, translated navigation strings, analytics configuration, dark mode, tabbed content, callouts, accordions/spoilers, Mermaid diagrams, ORCID and Carpentries icons, citation metadata, and development lifecycle badges. This repository is web infrastructure for educational/training materials rather than a hydrologic modeling or data-processing codebase.

Title: varnish-old
description: Template for NGIAB 101 tutorial - pkgdown site

summary_data.summary_text: CIROH-UA/varnish-old is a styling and HTML template repository for building a Carpentries Workbench/pkgdown lesson website, described as a template for an NGIAB 101 tutorial pkgdown site. The repository is based on the Carpentries {varnish} package, which is installed and used indirectly through {sandpaper} to copy CSS, JavaScript, favicons, and Mustache HTML templates into lesson websites. It provides customized pkgdown templates for lesson pages such as chapter/episode content, syllabus landing pages, overview pages, extra pages, headers, footers, side navigation, and overall layout. The build workflow compiles and minifies CSS and JavaScript from source assets using Node.js/npm, Sass, uglifyjs, and GitHub Actions. The templates support Carpentries Workbench lesson metadata, navigation, sidebar schedules, instructor view, all-in-one pages, resource links, lifecycle badges, Carpentry-specific favicons, analytics options, dark mode, callouts, tabbed content, spoilers, accessibility improvements, print formatting, and translation variables supplied by sandpaper. This repository is primarily infrastructure/theme code for training or tutorial websites rather than a hydrologic model implementation.

CIROH-UA/wpn-auth is a deployment repository for an AWS-based authentication and authorization solution that issues temporary access tokens to users from whitelisted email domains such as noaa.gov or ua.edu, or to specific whitelisted email addresses. The system stores temporary tokens in a DynamoDB table and uses those tokens to control access to data in a private S3 bucket served through a CloudFront distribution. A Lambda@Edge authorization function validates token-bearing requests when users access the CloudFront distribution, while a separate access Lambda grants tokens. The repository includes Terraform infrastructure code, a CloudFormation template defining the required AWS resources, settings, and permissions, and Lambda function folders. Manual setup notes include configuring Terraform variables, ensuring the private bucket name is unique, manually enabling CORS on API Gateway for the Terraform version, and configuring Amazon SES separately for the CloudFormation deployment.
